objective: Attribution audit on the already exposed 128-seed own-repair confirmation cohort. Vary only the source of rival starting cash. Compare forecast failures, branch choices and the same actual branch outcomes. No new-seed or current-opponent compatibility claim.
decision: Report every remaining failure and paired choice loss. Historical cash is a separate stress case, not credit added to the observed rival. A lower failure count does not establish valid current-state forecasts or pipeline promotion.
implementation: Unchanged fixed courses, own purchase repair, eight historical source calendars, and original selector. Default cash-splice control retained. No sale-rule changes or source-purchase normalization in this audit.
